<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_ComputerRepair" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/computer-repair">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DefectiveComputer" name="Defective computer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairCostCalculation" name="Repair cost calculation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AcceptCosts" name="Acceptance of repair costs"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RejectCosts" name="Rejection of repair costs"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Customer_Start" name="Decides to bring in defective computer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Customer_BringComputer" name="Bring defective computer to CRS" messageRef="Message_DefectiveComputer"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Customer_ReceiveCalculation" name="Receive repair cost calculation" messageRef="Message_RepairCostCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Customer_DecideCosts" name="Are the costs acceptable?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Customer_AcceptCosts" name="Accept repair costs" messageRef="Message_AcceptCosts"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Customer_RejectCosts" name="Reject repair costs" messageRef="Message_RejectCosts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Customer_TakeComputerHome" name="Take computer home unrepaired"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Customer_AcceptEnd" name="Repair accepted"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Customer_RejectEnd" name="Computer taken home unrepaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_1" sourceRef="Customer_Start" targetRef="Customer_BringComputer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_2" sourceRef="Customer_BringComputer" targetRef="Customer_ReceiveCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_3" sourceRef="Customer_ReceiveCalculation" targetRef="Customer_DecideCosts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_4" sourceRef="Customer_DecideCosts" targetRef="Customer_AcceptCosts">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${costsAcceptable}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_5" sourceRef="Customer_DecideCosts" targetRef="Customer_RejectCosts">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${not costsAcceptable}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_6" sourceRef="Customer_AcceptCosts" targetRef="Customer_AcceptEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_7" sourceRef="Customer_RejectCosts" targetRef="Customer_TakeComputerHome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_8" sourceRef="Customer_TakeComputerHome" targetRef="Customer_RejectEnd"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_CRS" name="CRS repair process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="CRS_Start" name="Receive defective computer">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="CRS_Start_MessageDefinition" messageRef="Message_DefectiveComputer"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="CRS_CheckDefect" name="Check defect"/>
    <bpmn:task id="CRS_CalculateCosts" name="Calculate repair costs"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="CRS_SendCalculation" name="Hand out repair cost calculation" messageRef="Message_RepairCostCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="CRS_WaitForDecision" name="Wait for customer decision"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CRS_CatchAcceptance" name="Receive acceptance">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="CRS_CatchAcceptance_MessageDefinition" messageRef="Message_AcceptCosts"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CRS_CatchRejection" name="Receive rejection">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="CRS_CatchRejection_MessageDefinition" messageRef="Message_RejectCosts"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="CRS_RejectedEnd" name="Repair not performed"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="CRS_InitialRepairSplit" name="Perform both repair activities"/>
    <bpmn:task id="CRS_RepairHardware" name="Check and repair hardware"/>
    <bpmn:task id="CRS_TestAfterHardware" name="Test system functionality after hardware repair"/>
    <bpmn:task id="CRS_ConfigureSoftware" name="Check and configure software"/>
    <bpmn:task id="CRS_TestAfterSoftware" name="Test system functionality after software configuration"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="CRS_InitialRepairJoin" name="Both repair activities completed"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="CRS_InitialErrorDecision" name="Is an error detected?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="CRS_ChooseFurtherRepair" name="Choose another repair activity"/>
    <bpmn:task id="CRS_FurtherHardwareRepair" name="Check and repair hardware"/>
    <bpmn:task id="CRS_TestFurtherHardware" name="Test system functionality after hardware repair"/>
    <bpmn:task id="CRS_FurtherSoftwareRepair" name="Check and configure software"/>
    <bpmn:task id="CRS_TestFurtherSoftware" name="Test system functionality after software configuration"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="CRS_FurtherRepairMerge" name="Further repair activity completed"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="CRS_FurtherErrorDecision" name="Is an error still detected?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="CRS_RepairFinished" name="Repair finished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CRS_Flow_1" sourceRef="CRS_Start" targetRef="CRS_CheckDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CRS_Flow_2" sourceRef="CRS_CheckDefect" targetRef="CRS_CalculateCosts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CRS_Flow_3" sourceRef="CRS_CalculateCosts" targetRef="CRS_SendCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CRS_Flow_4" sourceRef="CRS_SendCalculation" targetRef="CRS_WaitForDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CRS_Flow_5" sourceRef="CRS_WaitForDecision" targetRef="CRS_CatchAcceptance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CRS_Flow_6" sourceRef="CRS_WaitForDecision" targetRef="CRS_CatchRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CRS_Flow_7" sourceRef="CRS_CatchRejection" targetRef="CRS_RejectedEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CRS_Flow_8" sourceRef="CRS_CatchAcceptance" targetRef="CRS_InitialRepairSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CRS_Flow_9" sourceRef="CRS_InitialRepairSplit" targetRef="CRS_RepairHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CRS_Flow_10" sourceRef="CRS_InitialRepairSplit" targetRef="CRS_ConfigureSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CRS_Flow_11" sourceRef="CRS_RepairHardware" targetRef="CRS_TestAfterHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CRS_Flow_12" sourceRef="CRS_TestAfterHardware" targetRef="CRS_InitialRepairJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CRS_Flow_13" sourceRef="CRS_ConfigureSoftware" targetRef="CRS_TestAfterSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CRS_Flow_14" sourceRef="CRS_TestAfterSoftware" targetRef="CRS_InitialRepairJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CRS_Flow_15" sourceRef="CRS_InitialRepairJoin" targetRef="CRS_InitialErrorDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CRS_Flow_16" sourceRef="CRS_InitialErrorDecision" targetRef="CRS_ChooseFurtherRepair">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${errorDetected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CRS_Flow_17" sourceRef="CRS_InitialErrorDecision" targetRef="CRS_RepairFinished">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${not errorDetected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CRS_Flow_18" sourceRef="CRS_ChooseFurtherRepair" targetRef="CRS_FurtherHardwareRepair">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${hardwareRepairChosen}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CRS_Flow_19" sourceRef="CRS_ChooseFurtherRepair" targetRef="CRS_FurtherSoftwareRepair">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${softwareRepairChosen}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CRS_Flow_20" sourceRef="CRS_FurtherHardwareRepair" targetRef="CRS_TestFurtherHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CRS_Flow_21" sourceRef="CRS_TestFurtherHardware" targetRef="CRS_FurtherRepairMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CRS_Flow_22" sourceRef="CRS_FurtherSoftwareRepair" targetRef="CRS_TestFurtherSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CRS_Flow_23" sourceRef="CRS_TestFurtherSoftware" targetRef="CRS_FurtherRepairMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CRS_Flow_24" sourceRef="CRS_FurtherRepairMerge" targetRef="CRS_FurtherErrorDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CRS_Flow_25" sourceRef="CRS_FurtherErrorDecision" targetRef="CRS_ChooseFurtherRepair">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${errorDetected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CRS_Flow_26" sourceRef="CRS_FurtherErrorDecision" targetRef="CRS_RepairFinished">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${not errorDetected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ComputerRepair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CRS" name="CRS" processRef="Process_CRS"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Computer" name="Defective computer" sourceRef="Customer_BringComputer" targetRef="CRS_Start" messageRef="Message_DefectiveComputer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CostCalculation" name="Repair cost calculation" sourceRef="CRS_SendCalculation" targetRef="Customer_ReceiveCalculation" messageRef="Message_RepairCostCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Acceptance" name="Acceptance of repair costs" sourceRef="Customer_AcceptCosts" targetRef="CRS_CatchAcceptance" messageRef="Message_AcceptCosts"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Rejection" name="Rejection of repair costs" sourceRef="Customer_RejectCosts" targetRef="CRS_CatchRejection" messageRef="Message_RejectCosts"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
